description: This file defines the code-behind for the CalculatorProgrammerRadixOperators view in a calculator app, managing UI interactions, state changes, and resource loading related to bit shift operations and visual states.

classes.name: CalculatorProgrammerRadixOperators
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing the UI for radix operator settings in the calculator, handling bit shift modes, visual states, and resource strings.

methods.name: CalculatorProgrammerRadixOperators
methods.description: Constructor initializing visual state, component, and resource strings.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the DataContext cast to StandardCalculatorViewModel.

methods.name: IsErrorVisualState
methods.description: Property managing the error visual state and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: ParenthesisCountToString
methods.description: Converts a count to string, empty if zero.

methods.name: checkDefaultBitShift
methods.description: Sets default bit shift mode and enables related buttons.

methods.name: BitshiftFlyout_Checked
methods.description: Handles selection of bit shift mode via radio buttons, updates UI and announces selection.

methods.name: CollapseBitshiftButtons
methods.description: Collapses and disables all bit shift related buttons.

methods.name: LoadResourceStrings
methods.description: Loads resource strings for button labels.

methods.name: LoadDeferredLoadButtons
methods.description: Loads deferred button references if not already loaded.

methods.name: IsButtonLoaded
methods.description: Checks if bit shift buttons are loaded.

methods.name: OpenParenthesisButton_GotFocus
methods.description: Announces open parenthesis count when button gains focus.

methods.name: ClearEntryButton_LostFocus
methods.description: Focus management for clear entry button.

methods.name: BitShiftFlyout_Opened
methods.description: Restores the selected bit shift mode when flyout opens.
